metric.name: aggregate_generated_tokens_per_second
metric.definition: sum of actual generated tokens for the complete declared cohort divided by cohort wall seconds, from client admission start through receipt of every response
excludes_equally: one excluded warmup cohort per fresh server
metric.aggregation: mean paired-block percentage gain; not a ratio of accumulated percentages
metric.timer: HTTP request transmission start to complete response byte receipt; JSON parsing, validation and hashing excluded. Admission payload prepared before timer.

campaigns.limitation: This is one campaign. Overall confirmation requires both frozen ORIGINAL campaigns and all other goal checks. Replays are reported separately.

scope: AMD Ryzen5 5500U, same fixed six physical-core representatives of12 logical CPUs;8 concurrent distinct raw completions. No Intel measurement.
caveats: The original62-visit failed attempt is preserved and contributes no blocks to these statistics.
Raw REPLAY flags and original confirmation_success=false are unchanged; recovery success is separately registered and audited.
Heldout cohorts were unused for candidate selection but already observed in the failed attempt; they are not newly unseen prompts.
B0 is an exact historical-source rebuild, not byte identity to the unavailable historical binary.
Existing B0/B1 token differences and poor/repetitive raw-completion answers prevent a useful-answer or quality-superiority claim.
New C/C-off outputs are exact B1 reference matches. No model/GPU/speculation/answer or cross-request KV reuse.
C/B1 includes userspace and research scheduler. Same-policy scheduler pilot alone established no gain.
Point gain and bootstrap lower bounds are evidence within this scope, not a universal guaranteed minimum.
